**Yes—satellite evidence indicates tree-cover loss after 2020.** The tool detected 86.4 hectares of loss in qualifying patches during 2021–2023, mostly in 2021. At least 94% of each annual loss area overlapped land mapped as forest in 2020.

Tree-cover loss alone does not establish the cause or whether the land was converted to another use, so it is not by itself a definitive EUDR compliance determination.
